question: Uh, my payment failed but the money's gone, do I need to ask for a refund?
expected_answer: No: the payment never completed, so no order was placed and there is nothing to refund; the bank automatically reverses the debited amount back to the same account or card it came from.

key_facts: the payment did not complete, so no order was placed
the debited amount is automatically reversed to the original account or card

question: Uh, I paid cash on delivery, so how do I get my refund into my bank account?
expected_answer: You can't: refunds on cash on delivery orders are credited only to your Kosh Wallet as refund balance, within 2 hours of the refund being initiated, and can't be transferred to a bank account or UPI ID. The refund balance never expires and works on any future order.

key_facts: COD refunds are credited only to Kosh Wallet as refund balance
We cannot transfer COD refunds to a bank account or UPI ID
meta.common_prior: Add your bank account details or UPI ID and the refund is sent there by NEFT or UPI, usually within 5 to 7 working days.

question: You've processed my money back to UPI, how long till it reaches my account?
expected_answer: UPI refunds reach your account within 2 working days of the refund being initiated; if it hasn't arrived by then, support can give you the RRN so your bank can trace it.

key_facts: UPI refunds arrive within 2 working days of the refund being initiated

question: Okay, but the tracking hasn't moved since Monday, is that normal?
expected_answer: It can be: tracking only updates when the parcel is scanned at a hub or sorting centre, so while it's travelling between hubs there may be no new scans for a day or two, and that alone doesn't mean it's lost.
answer_aliases: no scans while in transit between hubs

history.content: Hi, I ordered a pressure cooker last week and it still hasn't come.
Let me check. It was handed over to the courier on Monday and it's in transit.

key_facts: tracking updates only when the parcel is scanned at a hub
a gap of a day or two while in transit does not mean the parcel is lost

question: The tracking says shipped now, does that mean I can't cancel?
expected_answer: Yes, once the status is Shipped it can't be cancelled in the app or by support; you can refuse the package when the delivery agent arrives, and for a prepaid order the refund is initiated once it's back at the warehouse, which can take up to 10 working days.
answer_aliases: refuse the package at the door

key_facts: orders can be cancelled only while the status is Ordered or Packed
a shipped order can be refused at the door; for prepaid orders the refund is initiated once the package is back at the warehouse, up to 10 working days
meta.plausible_wrong_answer: No, you can still cancel it from My Orders any time before it's delivered and get your refund straight away.

question: How long is a pincode supposed to be, your app won't accept mine?
expected_answer: An Indian pincode has six digits with no letters or spaces, so if yours has more or fewer digits the app will reject it.

key_facts: an Indian pincode has six digits

question: How many days does delivery usually take to a Guwahati pincode, roughly?
expected_answer: Guwahati is in Assam, and pincodes in the north-eastern states take 7 to 12 working days; large appliances and furniture aren't delivered there.

key_facts: Assam pincodes take 7 to 12 working days
Large appliances and furniture are not delivered to these regions

question: So why is there actually a cutoff time for same-day delivery on my order?
expected_answer: Because same-day orders have to be picked, packed and handed to the courier in time for that day's delivery runs, so there's a latest time you can order and still get it today; anything ordered after the cutoff goes out the next day instead.
answer_aliases: latest order time for same-day delivery

key_facts: orders must be picked, packed and handed to the courier in time for that day's delivery runs
the cutoff is the latest time you can order and still get same-day delivery; later orders go out the next day

question: So what time do I have to order by to get it the same day?
expected_answer: Order by 11 am and it's delivered by 10 pm the same day, for Swift-tagged products in metro pincodes; it costs ₹99 per order and is free for Club Elite members.

key_facts: Order by 11 am and it is delivered by 10 pm the same day
only for products tagged Swift in metro pincodes

question: Why did you add a delivery charge on my order, it was pretty small?
expected_answer: There's a ₹79 delivery charge on orders below ₹699, and delivery is free on orders of ₹699 or more; Club Plus and Club Elite members get free standard delivery on every order.

key_facts: ₹79 on orders below ₹699
free on orders of ₹699 or more

question: What does RTO mean on the tracking for my six hundred rupee COD order?
expected_answer: RTO means Return to Origin: the courier is sending the parcel back to the seller's warehouse, usually after failed delivery attempts or a refusal, so it won't be delivered to you.
answer_aliases: being sent back to the seller

key_facts: RTO stands for Return to Origin
the parcel is going back to the seller instead of being delivered

question: Um, why does cash on delivery cost more with you guys?
expected_answer: There's a COD fee of ₹49 per order, charged once per order rather than per item, and it's waived for Club Plus and Club Elite members.

key_facts: A COD fee of ₹49 per order
waived for Club Plus and Club Elite members

question: How do I measure my chest for a kurta so I don't have to return it?
expected_answer: Wrap a soft measuring tape around the fullest part of your chest, under the arms and across the shoulder blades, keeping it level and snug but not tight, then compare that number with the size chart.

key_facts: measure around the fullest part of the chest, under the arms
keep the tape level and snug, not tight, then compare with the size chart

question: Why did my refund for the kurta I sent back come ninety-nine rupees short?
expected_answer: A reverse pickup fee of ₹99 per return request is deducted from the refund; it's waived for Club Plus and Club Elite members and when the item is damaged, defective or not what you ordered.

key_facts: a pickup fee of ₹99 per return request is deducted from the refund
waived for Club Plus and Club Elite members, and when the item is damaged, defective or not what you ordered
meta.common_prior: Return pickups are free, so the shortfall is probably a coupon, offer discount or delivery charge being adjusted.

question: I got a kurta in the end of season sale, but can I return it?
expected_answer: Not for a refund: End of Season Sale purchases are Final Sale and can't be returned, but you can exchange it for a different size within 10 days of delivery, subject to stock.

key_facts: End of Season Sale purchases are Final Sale and cannot be returned for a refund
Final Sale items can be exchanged for a different size within 10 days of delivery
meta.common_prior: Yes, sale items can be returned for a refund within the normal return window as long as they're unused with tags on.

question: Why do I have to remove my Google account before sending a phone back?
expected_answer: Because of Factory Reset Protection: a phone still signed in to your Google account stays locked to it even after a reset, so nobody can test, reset or reuse it, and removing the account also keeps your data private.
answer_aliases: phone stays locked to your account

key_facts: Factory Reset Protection keeps the phone locked to the Google account even after a reset
removing the account lets the phone be checked and protects your data

question: What's the difference between the return days for a smartwatch and a shirt?
expected_answer: A shirt can be returned for a refund within 10 days of delivery (15 for Club Elite), but a smartwatch can't be returned for a refund at all; it can only be replaced within 3 days of delivery if it's dead on arrival, damaged, defective or wrong.

key_facts: smartwatches are not returnable for a refund and are eligible for replacement only within 3 days of delivery
fashion items can be returned within 10 days of delivery
meta.common_prior: Both can be returned for a refund within the usual return window, around 7 to 10 days, sometimes longer for clothing.

question: Can I call it dead on arrival if my speaker won't even switch on?
expected_answer: Yes, dead on arrival means a product that doesn't work when you first unbox and power it on, even if it looks undamaged, so a new speaker that won't switch on counts as DOA.
answer_aliases: doesn't work out of the box

key_facts: dead on arrival means the product doesn't work when first unboxed and powered on

question: My mixer jar came cracked, is there a time limit to report it?
expected_answer: Yes, you must report it within 48 hours of delivery, from My Orders, Help, Report an issue, with photos and, because a mixer counts as electronics, an unboxing video; after 48 hours it isn't accepted as a damaged item claim.

key_facts: report it within 48 hours of delivery
Reports made after 48 hours are not accepted under this process
electronics claims need an unboxing video
meta.common_prior: Any time within the normal return window, usually 7 to 10 days after delivery.

question: Do I need an unboxing video to claim my laptop came damaged?
expected_answer: Yes, for electronics and any order above ₹5,000 an unboxing video is required, recorded in one continuous take starting with the sealed package and its shipping label visible, plus photos, reported within 48 hours of delivery.

key_facts: For electronics, and for any order above ₹5,000, we also need an unboxing video
recorded in one continuous take starting with the sealed package

question: I'm on Plus, so what does early access to a sale mean, exactly?
expected_answer: Early access means you can shop the sale at sale prices before it opens to everyone else, so you get first pick of stock and sizes; it isn't by itself an extra discount on top of the sale price.
answer_aliases: shop the sale before everyone else
first pick before the public sale

key_facts: early access lets you shop the sale before it opens to everyone
it is not an extra discount by itself

question: Okay, and how much is that higher one for a year, then?
expected_answer: Club Elite costs ₹1,499 per year, charged upfront, and renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renew.

history.content: Hi, the app keeps asking me to upgrade my membership.
Sure, I can explain. We have two tiers, Plus and Elite.

key_facts: Club Elite costs ₹1,499 per year

question: What's the difference between cashback and a discount, if I pay either way?
expected_answer: A discount lowers the price you pay at checkout, while with cashback you pay the full price and part of it is credited back to you afterwards, usually as wallet balance or to your card for later use.
answer_aliases: discount at checkout vs money back later
cashback is credited after you pay

key_facts: a discount reduces the price at checkout
cashback means paying full price and getting part of it credited back afterwards

question: Does the money in my wallet expire if I don't use it?
expected_answer: It depends which balance: refund balance never expires, but Kosh Cash from cashback, rewards and referrals expires 30 days after it's credited.

key_facts: Refund balance never expires
Kosh Cash expires 30 days after it is credited
meta.plausible_wrong_answer: No, money in your wallet doesn't expire, so you can use it whenever you like.

question: Um, what's the validity on a gift card once I buy one, then?
expected_answer: Gift cards are valid for 1 year from the date of issue, and the balance keeps that expiry date even after you add it to your Kosh Wallet.

key_facts: valid for 1 year from the date of issue
keeps its original expiry date

question: How much interest do I pay on a no-cost EMI, is it zero?
expected_answer: Effectively yes, none: the bank does charge interest, but it's offset by an equal upfront discount, so your instalments add up to the product price; only things like GST on the interest or a bank processing fee can add to it.
answer_aliases: interest offset by an upfront discount

key_facts: the interest is offset by an equal upfront discount
the instalments add up to the product price

question: What does no-cost EMI actually cost me on your site, anything?
expected_answer: The interest is covered by an upfront discount, but the bank can charge a processing fee of up to ₹199 plus GST, and GST on the interest, which aren't covered; the processing fee isn't refunded if you cancel or return.

key_facts: processing fee of up to ₹199 plus GST, not covered by the discount
the processing fee is not refunded if you cancel or return the order
meta.plausible_wrong_answer: Yes, it's completely free: you pay exactly the product price split into instalments with no extra charges.

question: What happens if I miss paying it back on time?
expected_answer: The PayLater bill is due by the 5th of the next month; if it's unpaid after that, a late fee of ₹150 is charged and PayLater is paused until you clear it, and repeated late payments are reported to credit bureaus.

history.content: I bought running shoes with PayLater last week.
Yes, I can see that purchase on your PayLater account.

key_facts: the full bill is due by the 5th of the next month
A late fee of ₹150 is charged
PayLater is paused until the bill is cleared

question: How long should I keep the invoice for that, then?
expected_answer: Keep it for at least the whole warranty period, because the brand's service centre needs the invoice as proof of purchase and of the purchase date before it will repair the product under warranty.

history.content: I bought a Bluetooth speaker from you last month.
Yes, I can see the order. It's covered by the brand's warranty.

key_facts: keep the invoice for the full warranty period
the service centre needs it as proof of purchase and purchase date

question: What does the Assured Refurbished tag mean, like for the warranty?
expected_answer: Assured Refurbished devices are tested and graded by a refurbishment partner and carry a 6-month seller warranty from Tamarind Lane, not the brand's warranty; claims are picked up and repaired or replaced within 15 working days.

key_facts: a 6-month seller warranty from Tamarind Lane, not the brand's warranty
repair or replace it within 15 working days of pickup
